summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Real-time Notifications feature. All 19 backend API tests passed. Fixed critical frontend bug in NotificationCenterPage.jsx (useCallback hoisting issue). All UI components verified working: Notification Center page, Notification Preferences in Settings, header notification dropdown with View All button.

Backend: PUT /api/notifications/preferences - updates preferences successfully
Backend: GET /api/notifications/types - returns all 19 notification types in 5 categories
Backend: GET /api/notifications/paginated - returns paginated notifications with correct structure
Backend: GET /api/notifications/paginated?unread_only=true - filters unread notifications
Backend: GET /api/notifications/paginated?notification_type=task_assigned - filters by type
Backend: GET /api/notifications/unread-count - returns unread count
Backend: PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read - marks notification as read
Backend: PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read (invalid ID) - returns 404
Backend: PUT /api/notifications/read-all - marks all as read
Backend: DELETE /api/notifications/{id} - deletes notification
Backend: DELETE /api/notifications/{id} (invalid ID) - returns 404
Backend: GET /api/notifications/ - returns notifications list
Backend: GET /api/notifications/?limit=5 - respects limit parameter
Backend: Team member can access their preferences
Backend: Team member can update their preferences
Backend: Endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Frontend: Notification Center page loads at /notifications
Frontend: Notification Center shows All/Unread tabs
Frontend: Notification Center shows type filter dropdown
Frontend: Notification Center shows Refresh, Mark All Read, Settings buttons
Frontend: Notification Center displays notifications with icons, titles, messages, timestamps
Frontend: Header notification bell icon opens dropdown

Frontend: 'View all notifications' navigates to /notifications

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: NotificationCenterPage.jsx had useCallback hoisting issue - loadNotifications was used in useEffect before being defined. Moved useCallback definition before useEffect.

WebSocket endpoint at /api/notifications/ws/{token} is implemented but WebSocket connections show 'closed before established' warnings in console - this is expected behavior when navigating away quickly
Email notifications use Resend API (REAL integration, not mocked) - requires RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing notifications from previous testing.
